description: A party to a contract publishes an encryption public key for one tag; sent as the payload of a market.event. Anything sealed under that tag is sealed to the latest publicKey of the other side. Direction comes from the author: a requester-authored one is forwarded by the bidder to the guest's subscription; a bidder-authored one carries what the guest said.

kind.description: The key type. age-x25519: key is an age X25519 recipient (age1...).

tag.description: Names the tunnel of the contract (spec.tunnels) or another purpose the key is for.

key.description: The public key in the text form of kind.
